ValidationRule.description: SCRUM-464 AC4: a manufacturer on a case whose cause is NOT a third-party product is refused - the field stays empty for how-to, billing or our own misconfiguration. Refuse-a-value, never auto-clear: nothing is ever written behind the user's back (AC11).
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Kein Fabrikant: der Ursache of this case is not a third-party product, so no manufacturer may be recorded.
